title: Load Bonus Rates Across the Mountain Dining Plans
content:
Each of the Mountain Dining Plans earns a bonus on money loaded onto it, and each plan is sold with three bonus bands, a ceiling on the bonus it may earn over one season, and two additions that answer to other holdings the household keeps with the collective. This schedule holds the rates; the columns are the figure at which a band starts and the percentage of the load that band adds.

## Bonus bands

| Plan | First band from | First band rate | Second band from | Second band rate | Third band from | Third band rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | $100.00 | 2.5 per cent | $300.00 | 5 per cent | $600.00 | 7.5 per cent |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | $250.00 | 5 per cent | $750.00 | 7.5 per cent | $1500.00 | 10 per cent |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | $500.00 | 7.5 per cent | $1500.00 | 10 per cent | $3000.00 | 12.5 per cent |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | $1500.00 | 10 per cent | $4000.00 | 12.5 per cent | $8000.00 | 15 per cent |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | $3500.00 | 12.5 per cent | $8000.00 | 15 per cent | $16000.00 | 18 per cent |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | $9000.00 | 15 per cent | $20000.00 | 18 per cent | $40000.00 | 22 per cent |

## Season bonus ceiling, and the two additions

The ceiling is the most bonus the plan earns over one season. The passholder addition is the extra percentage a load earns where the household also holds a season pass in force; the lodging addition is the extra percentage a load earns where the household also holds collective lodging over the season.

| Plan | Most bonus in one season | Passholder addition | Lodging addition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | $150.00 | 0 per cent | 0 per cent |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | $500.00 | 2.5 per cent | 2.5 per cent |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | $1500.00 | 2.5 per cent | 2.5 per cent |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | $4500.00 | 5 per cent | 2.5 per cent |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | $12000.00 | 5 per cent | 5 per cent |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | $39000.00 | 7.5 per cent | 5 per cent |

One plan in the range carries no addition of either kind: on the Mountain Bites Dining Card both additions stand at 0 per cent, so neither of those other holdings changes what a load on that card earns. On every other plan in the range both additions stand above zero, and on the Alpine Club Dining Membership the passholder addition of 5 per cent is the larger of the two while the lodging addition is 2.5 per cent.
